ThingDef.label: servitor mining arm
ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement arm designed for mining servitors. The arm is composed of industrial micro-las emitters, several drill bits, scoops, and filters to sieve rare minerals from less valuable rock.

ThingDef.label: servitor industrial arm
ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement arm designed for manufactorum and construction servitors. The industrial version of the servitor arm has a clamp, a built in fusion welder and robust secondary manipulators to allow for better construction and crafting.

ThingDef.label: servitor agri-arm
ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement arm designed for agricultural servitors. The servitor agri-arm has a built in seed planter and fertilizer spreader to make farming easier. The fingers are replaced with multiple mechascythes that greatly speed up gathering work, but destroy a small amount of the harvest.
